(Japanese: '''リブート！冒険の世界へ！！''' ''Reboot! Off to the World of Adventure!!'') is the 137th episode of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', and the 1,369th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It is scheduled to air in Japan on May 22, 2026<!-- and is scheduled to air in the United States on *day*-->.
